title: Run focused renderer integration sweep for CLI web and desktop
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility wrappers in steam_deals_generator.py still cover current renderer entrypoints after extraction.
CLI, web, and desktop entry scripts import or invoke the generator without renderer-related import errors.
The first cut remains limited to renderers and does not pull cache, adapters, or orchestration into the refactor.
